name: @solutions-builder/specialist-runtime
description: What a specialist's sidecar tools and the host's build route share, below any agent runtime: deck authoring, delivery evidence, the packaging and deterministic checks of a build attempt, target verification, the environment a started process may inherit, and the artifact kinds the tools write. Shipped into a specialist's closure only when its entry imports a tool that uses it (#42); the app package re-exports these for the interface.
